[SWS_CM_90410] E2E_check for event serialized data
Upstream requirements:
RS_E2E_08540
⌈
For the given E2E-protected sample,
E2E_check
shall be invoked on the protected
serialized data (passed as argument
serializedData
to
E2E_check
) according to
[RS_E2E_08540] and [PRS_E2E_00323].
